# Cross-Functional Intelligence Sources

This directory records reproducible upstream sources used to improve `skills_UIUX` beyond pure UI/UX craft: product strategy, stakeholder decision framing, CRO/marketing copy, experimentation interpretation, search demand/content briefing and engineering/context discipline.

The upstream repositories are **knowledge sources**, not lifecycle orchestrators and not global prompt context. Local skills own capability boundaries and load deeper knowledge only when routed.

Policy:

1. Pin an exact upstream commit before adaptation.
2. Review the actual source and license; never infer behavior from a repository/skill name.
3. Prefer extending an existing local owner when workflow overlap is high.
4. Create a new local skill only for a distinct decision boundary.
5. Adapt claims that would otherwise become brittle absolutes (for example universal duration/link-count/context-window thresholds).
6. Keep project truth, Design Contract, accessibility/security/system reality and release authority above generic product/growth conventions.
7. External practices do not prove conversion, search, experiment or UX outcomes; project evidence/measurement still decides those claims.

See `SOURCE-LOCKS.md` for pinned refs and adoption decisions.
